description: This file defines the TailscaleService class responsible for managing Tailscale VPN integration within a macOS application. It handles status checking, app installation verification, and provides methods to open relevant Tailscale URLs. It also maintains internal state regarding Tailscale's operational status and network details.

classes.name: TailscaleService
classes.description: A singleton class managing Tailscale VPN status and operations on macOS.

methods.name: checkAppInstallation
methods.description: Checks if the Tailscale app is installed on the system by verifying the existence of its application directory.

methods.name: fetchTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the current Tailscale status from the local API endpoint and decodes the response.

methods.name: checkTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive status check, updating internal state regarding Tailscale installation, running state, IP, hostname, and errors, and triggers a refresh if needed.

methods.name: openTailscaleApp
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale application via the Finder.

methods.name: openAppStore
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale app page on the Apple App Store.

methods.name: openSetupGuide
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale installation/setup guide webpage.
